name: Emulate Aura (Su)
body:
Prerequisite: Disguise aura, sudden disguise

Benefit(s): The ninja has learned to mold her aura to match whatever mystic formation is required to activate magic items. The ninja may make a Disguise check in place of any Use Magic Device check. The ninja must have at least 1 ki point to use this trick.

Ultimate Options: Power of the Ninja © 2011, Rogue Genius Games, LLC; Author: Owen K.C. Stephens.
